- **PhoneDrop for Mac:** a native menu-bar app (Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 13+) that does everything the Windows app does: drop files, folders and APKs, pair with a QR code, and receive files shared from the phone. Download the `.dmg`. It isn't notarized by Apple, so the first time right-click PhoneDrop in Applications › Open. The Mac app doesn't update itself yet: download new versions from here.
- **Share to one of several PCs:** with two or more paired computers, the phone now always asks which one gets the file. Connected PCs are at the top; the others get it as soon as PhoneDrop runs there.
- **Security:** sharing to the PC only accepts files from other apps, and the phone's server refuses connections that come from the phone itself.
- The Windows text next to the QR code wraps instead of being cut off, and the Czech hint on the phone mentions the QR code.

Updating works in-app on Windows and Android (Updates on the phone, ⋯ → Update on Windows).
